source_clause: ALLPR1.) Profile order will default based on the order in which the Profiles have been added (defaults to the left and new Profiles added to the right)
leaf_desc_037: ALLPR1.) Profile order will default based on the order in which the Profiles have been added (defaults to the left and new Profiles added to the right)
reasoning: 驗證目標：5.12（ALLPR1）—— profile 之預設順序依加入之先後，預設者在左、新增者依序往右。關鍵情境條件：起始須**只有預設 profile**，否則「預設者在左」之比較無基準。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 之單位為**建立順序**；預設者彼此之順序屬 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-037`，編輯連結後之不變屬 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-038`。

tcs.tc_title: Profile order defaults to the order of creation
tcs.test_item: Profile order defaults to the order of creation
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Only the default Driver Profiles exist on the vehicle
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Create a new Driver Profile named Alex
2. Create a second new Driver Profile named Bea
3. Open the “All Profiles” tab and read the order of the Profiles
tcs.expected_result:
1. Driver Profile Alex is created
2. Driver Profile Bea is created
3. The default Profiles are shown on the left, then Alex, then Bea on the right
tcs.priority_basis: All Profiles 之預設排序；清單之呈現順序
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: **兩條新 profile 是必要的**：只造一條時，「新者在右」與「新者在最右」無從分辨，而一個把新 profile 插在最左之實作，單條測不出來。Alex／Bea 為測試設置（J-12）—— 條文未指定名稱。
